name: CoachMark
description: One stop of a tour: a non-modal popover anchored to its target, which holds the Located wash while the stop is open (design/patterns/coach-marks.md). The product owns the tour: which stop is open, the copy, and where focus goes when it ends.

props.name: anchor
props.description: What this stop is about, an element or a ref to one. While the stop is open its target holds the Located wash (`data-located="held"`); pass the whole row for a list row. A ref is read after every render, so a ref that moves to another element (a row given a new key) moves the wash too.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the person ends the tour from the bubble: Esc while focus is in it, or a `PopoverClose` in it. Skip and Done are the product's own buttons and call its own handlers. A press outside and focus leaving never close it, and Esc pressed anywhere else goes on to what has focus.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the stop is showing.

name: CoachMarkAction
description: One more thing the stop offers (Turn on notifications), an `outline` button on its own row under the text.

name: CoachMarkActions
description: The bubble's last row: `CoachMarkCount` at the start, then Skip and `CoachMarkNext` at the end.

name: CoachMarkContent
description: The bubble: 300px, 8px from its target and at least 8px from the window's edge (or frame inset), with an arrow on whichever side it opens.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary: 8px from the window's edge, and 8px from a frame inset where a shell keeps one. A value you pass is kept as it is.

props.name: align
props.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description: Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.

props.name: disableAnchorTracking
props.description: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.

props.name: positionMethod
props.description: Determines which CSS `position` property to use.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against. May automatically change to avoid collisions.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after the anchor element was scrolled out of view.

name: CoachMarkCount
description: Which stop this is, "2 of 6", in Space Mono.

name: CoachMarkNext
description: Next, or Done on the last stop: the pink button, and where focus goes when the stop opens.

props.name: loading
props.description: Busy: shows the spinner and blocks activation (click, Enter, Space and form submission) while keeping the button focusable. A busy button is `aria-disabled`, not natively `disabled`, so the focus a press left on it stays there and is still there when the wait ends.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: The spinner's accessible name while `loading`: say what is happening.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (32px) and `icon-md` for rows, cards, banners, toolbars and panel headers; `lg` and `icon-lg` (the control height) for dialog footers, forms and beside a field; `xl` for a full-width call to action. The size follows the place: see Button › Size by place.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
